They were later identified as 42 year-old, Daniel Demetrius and  41 year-old, Ponder Kell. The officer was unable to turn his bodycam on during initial contact because he was in a hurry to break the fight. When the officer tried to get their information, Dainel ran away. One of the officer chased Daniel and the other remained on scene and spoke with Ponder  Watch till the end for the full details about the charges. Dainel was charged with obstructing and officer and was also taken into custody for multiple pending warrants.
